install_contract: Run native frozen sync while preserving editable dependencies at their upstream base gitlinks.
Check this bundle against the explicit native repository root, then apply it and check again.
Install ported Xiaomi wheels with --no-deps. Xiaomi toolkit reference commit: 10216e63f9bc78a053f253bd4fbf2e0b45481a84; toolkit is not bundled here.
Run the native runtime with --no-sync. Do not run a normal Xiaomi uv sync that replaces the native dependency pins.
